# Atelier — API Reference (llms.txt)

> Machine-consumable index. Deep detail: `atelier` skill package; runtime queries via MCP (`registry.*`, `tokens.list`, `state.*`).

## Core primitives (atelier/runtime)

| API | Signature | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `<?>` state | `$state<T>(init) → Signal<T>` | `signal.value` read/write; write triggers microtask-batched update |
| derive | `$derived<T>(fn) → Signal<T>` | lazy cache; read-only (ATR-305 on write) |
| effect | `$effect(fn) → cleanup` | subscribes to deps read inside fn |
| component | `component(fn, { name, schema }) → ComponentDef` | fn returns `html\`...\`.locals({...})` |
| html | `html\`...\`` (tagged template) | `.locals(obj)` injects scope (compiler captures later) |
| stream | `streamValue<T>() → { values, value, done, push, finish }` | streaming text/values; no manual setInterval |
| optimistic | `optimisticList<T>() → { values, optimisticAdd, commit, revert }` | pending → committed / rollback |
| store | `store.commit/rollback/timeTravel/list` | named checkpoints; app-state only (source = git, decision 15) |
| graph | `store.graph(keyOf?)` | live dependency graph (signals + effect edges); keyOf remaps ids |
| log | `store.log(n)` | $state mutation journal (seq/at/sig/from/to, bounded ring) |
| validate | `validateFlat(schema, data)` → `{ ok, error?: AtrError }` | flat schema (no $ref/oneOf); leaf constraints min/max/pattern |

## Template DSL

`{expr}`（对象/数组字面量 `{{a: x.value}}`、`{a}` 简写）· `{#if}{:else if}{:else}{/if}` · `{#each arr as item, idx [by key]}` · `on:click={handler}` · `attr={expr}`（含对象字面量）· void 元素 `<br>/<img>/<input>` · `<StyleBlock scoped>` — 解析期显式拒绝未闭合/错位结构（ATR-101）。

## Contract (flat schema)

```json
{ "type": "object", "reqProps": { "name": { "type": "string" } },
  "optProps": { "status": { "type": "string", "enum": ["running", "done"] } } }
```
Rules: pure data, literal discriminants, no generics, no $ref/oneOf.

## CLI

| Command | Flags |
|---|---|
| `atelier init [--ai]` | --ai generates AGENTS.md/SKILL.md/llms.txt/specs |
| `atelier dev` | — |
| `atelier review` | — |
| `atelier check` / `lint` / `test` | — |
| `atelier snapshot [--update]` | — |
| `atelier e2e` | — |
| `atelier build [--static]` | --static = SSG |
| `atelier package [--electron]` | Tauri 2 default |

## Errors

`{ code, message, context, fix }` — domains: 1xx compile / 2xx contract / 3xx runtime / 4xx MCP. Table: `skills/errors/codes.md`.

## Design tokens

`atelier.config.json → tokens` is the only source; `--color-primary` etc.; missing token = ATR-204.

## Packages

`atelier` (runtime/cli) · `@atelier/compiler` · `@atelier/eslint` · `@atelier/config` · `@atelier/review` · `create-atelier`
